title: fix(cloud-connection): install-local judges datasource-name holders with one judge that reads the engine and fails closed, and a rehydrate never takes over a held name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxHicY1SvtJqLC6d7EFA3M2v)_
Fixes #28143

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:本地安装包(install-local)时,判断"数据源名字是否已被别人占用"改由 runtime 里唯一的判定函数 `datasourceNameHolder` 来做;它除了读元数据,还读引擎上的驱动和代码数据源集合,读不到时拒绝安装(503),不再放行。重启时的 rehydrate 遇到被别人占用的名字,不再接管,只记一条 error 日志;卸载只关闭包自己打开的连接池。
- 为什么改:三个漏洞都在 main 上实测成立:元数据读失败时安装照样 200;只在引擎上注册的数据源(旧的 onEnable 桥)看不见,安装 200;早于 #28039 安装的包在重启时会覆盖 Setup 里同名数据源、把它变成只读,卸载时还会关掉 Setup 的连接池。
- 风险与回滚:只影响声明了数据源的包;新增的拒绝只在名字确实被占或读不到时出现。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/declared-datasources.ts`(`datasourceNameHolder`、`leaveHeldNames`、`withdrawPackageDatasources` 的 `found` 判断),`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 2a 段与 `findHeldDatasourceName`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/declared-datasources.test.ts`,预期 17 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One judge, in the runtime.** `@objectstack/runtime` exports `datasourceNameHolder(ctx, appId, name)` → `free | held (holder) | unreadable (reading, cause)`. It reads, in order: the host's `default`; the metadata registry (an item not stamped with the package: a Setup row, another package's); the code-datasource set (a name another installed package recorded, or one the host registers from code); the data engine (`objectql.getDriverByName`, a driver with no metadata item: the legacy `onEnable` bridge). The package's own earlier registration or recorded pool is `free`, so a reinstall passes. An absent service holds nothing; a read that throws is `unreadable`, never `free`.
- **Install door, step 2a** (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`) judges with it. A held name is the existing `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`details.datasource`), now including an engine-only holder. A holder that cannot be read is `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with `details: { datasource, reading }`, before any write, worded like the access-upgrade check's 503 ("a check that did not run is never taken for no holder"). A runtime without the judge is that 503 as well.
- **Installed calls of `connectPackageDatasources`** (install and every rehydrate) judge each declared name after withdrawing the package's own earlier registrations. A held or unreadable name is left out of all three steps (no code registration, not recorded in the code-datasource set, not connected), and one `error` line names each, its holder, the consequence and the remedy. The boot path (`installed` unset) is unchanged and still hands `connectDeclared` the very list it was given.
- **Uninstall closes only what the package opened.** The per-package record now keeps, beside the names, the ones whose connect answered `already-registered`; the withdrawal does not `disconnect` those (their holder's pool), while still removing the package's registration and name.

## Why

The three edges the card names, each measured on `origin/main` `75ecaf4a` before the fix, with the tests below run against the unchanged source:

1. **Read fault fails open.** `metadata.get` throwing → the install answered `200` (`expected 200 to be 503`).
2. **Engine-only holder unseen.** A driver on the engine with no metadata item → the install answered `200` (`expected 200 to be 409`).
3. **Rehydrate takes over a Setup row.** With a Setup row and its pool holding `pkg_store`, an installed call returned `pkg_store`'s verdict alongside the package's other datasource (it registered, recorded and "connected" the name); and an uninstall disconnected a pool the connect had only found (`disconnected` was `['pkg_store','pkg_vault']`, expected `['pkg_vault']`).

The card's choice for (1)+(2) was "fail closed or read the engine": both are done, since the engine read alone does not close (1).

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/declared-datasources.test.ts`: 9 new cases. The judge: each holder kind (default, Setup row, another package, engine-only), a code-set name, a metadata or engine read fault is `unreadable`, the package's own registration and recorded pool are `free` (with a control from another package's side), nothing anywhere is `free`. The installed call: a Setup row is not taken over and the uninstall leaves its pool and item alone; an engine-only holder is not taken over; an unreadable holder is not taken over and is reported; a pool found `already-registered` is not disconnected by the uninstall. The fake kernel gained an opt-in engine whose driver registry the fake connect fills, as the real one does.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-datasource-holder.test.ts` (new): through the real install route, a metadata read fault answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and writes no ledger entry or registration; an engine-only holder answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; a control with an unrelated engine driver installs `200`.

## Acceptance notes

- **"Records it on the install record"** is read as the runtime's per-package install record (what the uninstall reads): a held name is not in it, so the uninstall never touches it. The rehydrate's report is the `error` line. Nothing new is added to the GET listing or the ledger file; a listing marker like `notLoaded` would be a separate wire decision.
- **A kernel with no `metadata` service** is not an outage: no metadata holder can exist there, and the package's own registration is skipped the same way, so the judge goes on to the code set and the engine rather than refusing.
- **On a rehydrate, an unreadable holder is left alone too** (not taken over, reported), which leaves that package datasource unconnected until a restart reads the holder.
- One file outside the claimed surface: `packages/runtime/src/index.ts`, the barrel line exporting `datasourceNameHolder` and its type.

## Verification

All readings are on head `6aa099f6af` (base `origin/main` `75ecaf4a`; the 5 commits main gained since touch none of these files), in a dedicated worktree.

- **Measured on main first:** the two new test files run against the unchanged source of each package: cloud-connection `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)` (`expected 200 to be 503`, `expected 200 to be 409`, control green); runtime `Tests 9 failed | 8 passed (17)` (the 5 judge cases have no export to call; the 4 installed-call cases fail on the takeover and the eviction).
- **runtime:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build && test && typecheck` under the verify lock → `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `Test Files 492 passed (492)`, `Tests 8010 passed | 19 skipped (8029)`.
- **cloud-connection:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test && typecheck` under the lock → `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `Test Files 63 passed (63)`, `Tests 768 passed (768)`.
- **Dogfood, the one file this path owns:** `install-local-declared-datasources.dogfood.test.ts` after a full `pnpm build` → `Tests 8 passed (8)` (refusals of `showcase_external` and `default`, install, uninstall, rehydrate all unchanged).
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 60 commands; all 60 exited 0. Three first answered `3` / timed out for a missing prerequisite (teardown-shape self-test on a shallow clone; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` without a full build; `check:type-check-debt` cut by my own 300 s cap during its closure build) and were re-run to exit 0 after `git fetch --unshallow` and a full `pnpm build`. `--ran`: `60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- **Lint:** `pnpm lint` → exit 0.
- `check:platform-checklist` not run: nothing exported is renamed or removed (one export added).
- Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm on the claim's `Clause-②:` line).

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, not kept)</summary>

Each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock; the unit suites import the mutated module from source, so no rebuild was involved. Predictions written before each run.

1. `declared-datasources.ts`, anchor `if (holding.status === 'free') continue;` → `… || holding) continue;` (nothing is ever left out). Predicted the three not-taken-over cases red. `anchor 1 -> 0, blob ddb9ddcbc7ef -> 6f7e7e257f17`; `Tests 3 failed | 14 passed (17)`, exactly those three; restored `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. `declared-datasources.ts`, the withdrawal's `&& !record?.found.has(name)` dropped (every recorded pool closed). Predicted the found-pool case red. `anchor 1 -> 0, blob ddb9ddcbc7ef -> 334b4cea3bdb`; `Tests 1 failed | 16 passed (17)`; restored `blob == HEAD`.
3. `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, the 503 branch made unreachable (a guard that is always false: the current time is negative). Predicted the read-fault case red. `anchor 1 -> 0, blob 86f1411152ed -> 32eb6f3d33e1`; `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`; restored `blob == HEAD`.
</details>
